title: Environmental Economics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the final users of goods and services and the owners of resources."
Households are the final users of goods and services and the owners of resources.

The environment is the supplier of all forms of resources. 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the combined structure involving human to human interactions."
The social environment refers to the combined structure involving human to human interactions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of individually demanded quantities at the various prices."
Market demand is the sum of individually demanded quantities at the various prices.

The Supply Curve is a graph illustrating how much of a given commodity sellers (firms) would sell at different prices.
